question: Methotrexate-based interception in at-risk arthralgia
current_form: Selection is by baseline MRI inflammatory burden (multiple sites of tenosynovitis with or without osteitis), not by ACPA status. Signal is post-hoc, not prespecified, no interaction test, 13 events in 66 participants.
next_step: Re-analysis of existing individual-participant data: does baseline MRI burden modify treatment effect (predictive) or only mark prognosis?
blocked_on: Discretionary data request to the trial's corresponding author; no repository route exists.

question: Stromal-directed therapy in molecularly selected RA
current_form: No stromal-directed agent has been tested in a biopsy- or signature-selected RA population. Pauci-immune/fibroid resistance is drug-specific, not universal.
next_step: (a) Records enquiry: did the TRAFIC part 2 efficacy stage enrol or report? (b) Drug-agnostic validation of the stromal signature in existing synovial-biopsy cohorts.
blocked_on: TRAFIC part 2 status is not in any public record; signature validation depends on what existing cohort interfaces expose.

question: Non-immunosuppressive strategy for imaging-negative refractory RA
current_form: The question is already under randomised test, and imaging has failed as a treatment-decision biomarker in three prior trials.
next_step: None proposed. Await the ongoing randomised trial.

question: IL-1 stratification and the unreported anti-IL-1alpha trial
Rechallenge-defined food-intolerance subgroup
current_form: Blinded food-challenge work runs 1983-2006; average effect is negative, with a positive signal confined to a rechallenge-defined subgroup. Twenty years of silence since 2006.

question: Whether sham acupuncture is inert in RA
current_status: CLOSED — reclassified as a methodological caveat
current_form: Retained as a caveat attached to every RA acupuncture conclusion, not as a therapeutic direction.
